## What this project is (30 seconds)

*Enter The Matricks* (working title; **codename ETM**, see P-16) is a seated VR survival shooter for **Meta Quest 2, 3 and 3S** (one build; Quest 2 is the performance floor, P-31) in **Unreal Engine 5**. The player sits in an open industrial exoskeleton (RIG-6) and fires two independently aimed heavy pulse cannons to hold off an alien-machine invasion while Haven Nine evacuates. The campaign is two 10-minute missions with two bosses.

## Gotchas

- Don't trust the old concept art for gameplay. It shows ammo counters, a canopy, miniguns, beams, and franchise terms. All of these are wrong.
- Sustained dual-cannon output is about **181 dps**, not the 320 dps peak. Tune encounters against 181.
- Venting is **disabled** while a cannon is overheat-locked (P-01). This is intentional.
- Every task lists owned `paths`. The game repo's pre-commit hook will reject files outside them.
- On Windows the hooks call `python3`; if that is the Microsoft Store stub, put a `python3` shim that runs `py -3` on PATH.
- The editor rewrites `Config/DefaultEngine.ini` with a per-machine AndroidFileServer token. Never commit that change.
- Test files keep helpers in anonymous namespaces; the module has `bUseUnity = false` so they cannot clash (T-0044).
